**Answer:** The experiment involves recruiting patients with neurological disorders and dividing them into two groups. Group A will use a traditional brain-computer interface, while Group B will use a newly developed brain-computer interface. Patients in Group A will be trained to use their own brain signals to control a robotic arm, while patients in Group B will use the brain-computer interface to control a computer mouse. The experiment will measure the accuracy, speed, and comfort of the patients in both groups.
